description.value: The 112 Restaurant & Lounge is a long-established fine dining destination inside Revelstoke's Regent Hotel, serving the community since 1978. The menu leans on regional ingredients—wild BC salmon, braised bison short ribs, charbroiled steaks—paired with craft cocktails and local beers. Regular live music nights make it a lively spot for a post-ride evening meal in the heart of downtown Revelstoke.
